 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = next((v for v in set(sum(grid, [])) if all(x == v for x in grid[0]) and sum(all(x == v for x in row) for row in grid) >= 1), None)
    # ARC board: uniform separator rows/columns; cells with at least two target marks become 1.
    separator_rows = [r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]

    # Use detected uniform lines; target mark is the non-background, non-separator color.
    bg = max(set(sum(grid, [])), key=sum(grid[r][c] == v for r in range(h) for c in range(w)))
    sep_color = grid[separator_rows[0]][0] if separator_rows else grid[0][separator_cols[0]]
    marks = [v for v in set(sum(grid, [])) if v not in (bg, sep_color)]
    mark = marks[0]
    r_edges = [-1] + separator_rows + [h]
    c_edges = [-1] + separator_cols + [w]
    out = []
    for ra, rb in zip(r_edges, r_edges[1:]):
        if rb == ra + 1: continue
        row = []

            if cb == ca + 1: continue
            n = sum(grid[r][c] == mark for r in range(ra+1, rb) for c in range(ca+1, cb))

        out.append(row)
    return out
